lines.text: Why is a football called a pigskin?
Early footballs used pig bladders, blown up by mouth.
The soft bladder needed a stiff leather cover to keep its shape.
Today the cover is cowhide, and a pro ball weighs fourteen to fifteen ounces.
So the pigskin is really cowhide. Next, how short the first Moon walk was.
